runs.note: BASELINE. Score = 4/33. Emerald is recommended #1 for 'commercial masonry contractor for HOA Chicagoland' (its own site ranks) but is ABSENT for nearly every other query — best-contractor, tuckpointing, chimney repair, parapet, even its own HQ city (Palos Heights). Answer engines ground on directories (Yelp, Thumbtack, Angi, Houzz, BBB, HomeAdvisor, downtobid, Porch) and competitors with per-city/per-service pages (Bruno, Shamrock, TOP Masonry, ADV, Acorn, Paul Lally's — the latter literally next door at 7156 W 127th St). TWO data-integrity problems surfaced: (1) an AI answer cited phone (309) 323-9959 (a Peoria area code) for Emerald — not present anywhere in the repo, so it is being pulled from an external listing; the business's own Facebook page is labeled 'Peoria IL' and is the likely source. (2) Severe brand/entity confusion — BBB lists unrelated 'Emerald Masonry' entities in PA, MN, and Seattle WA, which AI blends with the Chicagoland business.
